title: Count Operations to Obtain Zero
goal: Count repeated larger-minus-smaller operations until one number reaches zero.
strategy: A run of identical subtractions is one division quotient. Add that quotient to the operation count and replace the larger value with its remainder, following the Euclidean algorithm.
